plugin.name: Arcade Machine
plugin.description: Three office games in your IDE: Turkish Wordle, Higher / Lower and live drawing rooms. Connect to your office's Arcade Machine LAN server for shared daily challenges and live leaderboards.
plugin.change-notes: Drawing rooms now have a compact canvas-first layout with icon-only controls. Pick colors from one popup with RGB sliders, numeric values and sixteen presets. New line, rectangle and ellipse tools preview locally, synchronize on release and support whole-gesture undo. Repeated room, score and instruction text is hidden during play; exhausted hint controls disappear. Existing room settings, scores and server 0.3.4 compatibility are preserved.
